top_signals.title: US Futures Drop, Led by Tech, as Bond-Yield Spike Sparks Angst
top_signals.summary: US stock futures fell before the bell on Tuesday as rising bond yields and an early-morning spike in oil prices unnerved investors, prompting them to pare back some of their riskier trades, such as bets on AI and related tech.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Commodity repricing impacting inflation expectations and industrial supply chains.

top_signals.title: German drone maker Helsing enlists Rakuten to broker Japan military deal
top_signals.summary: German drone maker Helsing has enlisted Japanese e-commerce and finance firm Rakuten to help finalize a deal to sell its unmanned systems to Japan’s army.
top_signals.why_it_matters: Geopolitical escalation affecting commodities, shipping and cross-asset volatility.

top_signals.title: US Air Force looks to acquire target drones that can mimic stealth jets
top_signals.summary: The U.S. Air Force wants to acquire target drones that can mimic the performance of a variety of aircraft, from stealth fighters to small UAVs.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.

top_signals.title: South Africa Proposes Sweeping Changes to Power-Price Framework
top_signals.summary: South Africa proposed sweeping changes to its electricity-tariff framework, the biggest overhaul of its pricing policy in almost two decades.

top_signals.title: Who’s Tracking You? Use This New Service to Find Out
top_signals.summary: It can be daunting to determine who's responsible for showing ads on the websites we visit, or who's harvesting data from the mobile apps we use every day. That information is already semi-public, but it is not easily parsed and traditionally much of it has remained walled away in the hands of large advertising platforms. Not anymore: A powerful and free new service called DecryptAds scrapes and correlates this adtech data and makes it simple to quickly learn a great deal about the entities that are tracking you.
top_signals.why_it_matters: AI and semiconductor developments impacting technology leadership and capex cycles.
